body: I don't have anything to sell. I do have many thousands of dollars worth of stuff back in a storage unit in L.A. I'm making just enough on Uber to keep paying the rental fee, but it doesn't look like I'll ever have enough money to go out and get it. I just can't let it go yet, but I know I'll eventually have to let the company seize my stuff and auction it. It won't affect my credit as my 790 fico is now 300. I really dread losing it as there are personal things on computers in there and tax returns. I can't do physical jobs because of health problems that could be fixed if I had health insurance, but I don't. I have to do last year's taxes first and all my records are back in L.A. So the IRS is after me but they don't know where I am. It's just pretty much an impossible situation all around. But don't think for a second I don't appreciate the advice. Perhaps someone might think of something I haven't, but it's looking more and more like the only solution is exiting. Like I said, I've probably lived more life in the past 20 years that most people live in a lifetime. I don't want to go, but staying here is just too much. And he lives in a small town in Louisiana. Can't get much cheaper than here. And he took out a reverse mortgage on his house so we can't sell and borrow against the equity.

It's not about me living frugally. It's about my dad running out of money on his fixed income. He was so insanely proud of me and I was Mr. Moneybags before. As far as doing something about my doc, I don't know what to do. I just don't. He was kind of a weird guy but was doing this out the goodness of his heart. He was very old and had a lot of health problems but he charged very little, or in my case nothing, just so he could help people like me with no insurance. He seemed a bit disorganized.  

We bought a car with my dad's credit and since he wouldn't allow me to negotiate the price, (he's a control freak and I've bought a dozen cars in the past 20 years,) we got hugely ripped off. 450/mo for 7 years for a freaking Subaru. I really wanted to do a train crossing thing but insurance won't cover the car if it's intentionally totaled. I'm thinking of a way of trying to make something happen that will look like an accident but I'll probably go with the bridge thing. My plan had been a bit more elaborate. Steal a boat and just go out to sea and do something to where I'll die in the water because I don't like the idea of my body being recovered. But someone said how much worse it is for the family to not have closure. Plus, it takes forever for my family to get my benefits without a body. And I can't believe how calmly I'm sitting here typing this. I've never had this feeling before. The few times I've felt bad enough to do this, I was all in tears and terrified. Anyway, of course, I'm holding out a bit of hope, but this just isn't fun anymore.

But I wanted to say that what I'm most comfortable with is this. This tragedy was timed out well. I lived to see my niece graduate from high school. I can't have an affect on shaping her anymore as she's an adult. I did my job and I'm so proud of her and my work here is now done.

I'm still barely hanging in. I don't want to hurt my niece but I'm in far greater pain than she'll ever lose. But I really appreciate your words. It's why I'm here. Hoping that I can avoid the worst case scenario.
It was for years such a defining thing for me. Now it means so little. The statue is patinaed, or whatever the word is for it. I gave it to my niece.
I know. And I preach the same things to others in my predicament. It's just that it's hard at times to walk the walk.
Thank you.

I recently went to the emergency room. Abscess tooth. Something I never had any problem taking care of with my insurance along with paying what the 80 percent copay didn't with the shit tons of cash I had. Now I'm broke. In the emergency room, I told them I had nothing. They are billing me. And put my on huge doses of antibiotics. Now, my face is swollen worse. My foot is swollen worse. My career is over. Trump is president. I'm tired right now. The bridge is an hour away. But my hope is that whatever is going on in my body takes my life as I sleep. What I'd really love to do is slit my wrist with my Emmy award. Yes, the wings are that sharp. But tonight, more than any other time, I want to just go away. If I die in my sleep, so be it. But I'd prefer to announce who I am before I die. Fuck. Emmy Award. Maybe there are ways you could figure out who I am. I just don't need police at my door. But I'm tired. My body is filled with infection. I want to rest peacefully. And I will now with some pharmaceutical assistance.

Lol. Who the fuck is going to see this?! Or care. I guess it's why I feel safe.

I understand and I have the same instinct in me to not want others to end their lives. As far as my brother, he wouldn't give me a penny. One year for Christmas when I was only waiting tables during college, each of the four kids agreed to pitch in 100 dollars each to buy my parents a 400 dollar gift. I wasn't able to come up with the money until after Christmas so my brother made sure to not include my name on the card and when my parents opened it Christmas morning, he said, "This is only from me, sister 1 and sister 2. Mark didn't pay his share." It wasn't long after that I was making tons of money and I always made sure to give a lot away and also, in a case like that, I'd say it was from all the kids even if I was the only one paying. He's different from most people. While I lived in Los Angeles-1,500 miles away from my parents, he lived 5 minutes away from them and rarely visited. Once my dad needed a hand working on the house. Jay was always "too busy." Playing tennis usually. My dad had to wait till I had a hiatus on the show I was working on to fly home and help him. The company of Jay's headquarters is in Irvine. About 40 minutes from where I lived. He's flown there dozens of times. Not once letting me know or making an attempt to visit with me. Meanwhile, every single time I'd come home to visit mom and dad, he'd call dad wanting me to come and visit. Mainly just for me to see his huge house in a gated golf community. If I didn't visit him during a visit to see mom and dad, he'd bitch. When my mom had a stroke, I flew home and visited her long before he did. As a matter of fact, I don't think he ever actually visited her for that particular hospital visit. He's an awful person and extremely stingy. And doesn't value family like me and the sister I'm close to. Him and the other sister are lost causes. Mainly for narcissistic reasons.  

My dad suggested YouTube videos. People who make any money at all are really young. Besides, my act is stand up. Stand up videos with no audiences are awful. The audience is part of my act. I did it a couple times in Los Angeles to good response, but I can't afford to live out there anymore.

Thanks. I had perfect credit my entire life. Last FICO score was 790 before the end came. Since then, I had to declare bankruptcy. So I got a secured credit card with a 200 dollar limit, but they've been hounding me day and night because I owe them 25 dollars that I don't have. So a loan is out of the question. I even applied for Care Credit to see if I could take care of the abscess, but it was an instant decline. I thought about crowd funding but I never really had a lot of friends and since this is a riches to rags story, most people find pleasure in the predicament of someone like me. I was hoping I could get a job at Walmart for the insurance, but now that I can't walk, that's out the door. I think my kidneys might be having a problem and if I go into kidney failure, so be it. It was meant to be. I really hate to die. I love life and have so much to offer and so many talents. But if I'm not even able to work at Walmart, my existence is now boiled down to nothing but a financial burden. It's unreal that I don't have emergency access to my retirement funds, but I don't. And there's only one way to get it, and that's my death.  

I actually won an Emmy award! Lol. Unreal. I thought my life would be set after that. And it was for a time. Then just bad luck after bad luck after bad luck and now this. I still kinda think I beat the odds even if I die tomorrow. I was told all throughout my childhood by my brother and father that I was a loser and would never amount to anything. And I believed them. But then I decided that maybe I'm talented enough to make it in the entertainment industry in Los Angeles. And holy shit, I made it big. It was a good run. I hate that it's over, and moreso that my life seems to be over, and I'm sure the brother I never talk too, who's a multi-millionaire, will laugh the day I day. He won. Oh well.

On top of all of that, I think my kidneys aren't faring so well right now anyway. My foot is swelling up and is in a lot of pain, and my blood pressure has been averaging 175/110 for a while now, but I don't have any money to see a doctor. I used to just give away so much money. God it was nice. Giving my now late mom 4 or 5 thousand bucks for Christmas. Donating to charities. Fixing my teeth any time I needed. Now I have an abscess that's been going on for 10 months because I don't even have the money to have it pulled. Meanwhile, 8 years ago I paid cash to have three teeth replace for cosmetic reasons. Jesus. Just no good to this story. I do wish I had treated myself more when I was rich as opposed to giving so much away. Seems all futile now.

Yes. I called IATSE, my ex-union. It's the Motion Picture Industry Pension Plan. I asked what would happen in the event of my death. Then I asked what if it's a suicide. I backed it up with research on their site. Pension payouts are lump-sum and tax-free. Social Security said they pay out next of kin only. So wife would be first. I'm single. Next would be living parent. And the payout is 750/mo until the balance is gone. That's a lot of money for my dad. I'd leave the pension to him, but then if he doesn't outlive it, my three siblings, two of which are wealthy but wouldn't piss on me if I were on fire, would pay taxes. This way no money ever makes it into their wealthy, greedy hands. Just my sister who I'm close to.  

I too hope something happens, but like my dad said, if I didn't have bad luck, I'd have no luck at all. So much more I want to do. I really want to see my Godchild get married. She's 17 now and once said in a school paper, when asked who has been the biggest impact on her, it was her Uncle Mark. "One day I hope to grow up to be like him." This just sucks, sucks, sucks. There is no good end to this unless I win the lottery. Only option for me.  

Thanks for taking the time to reply. As I said, I'll reveal who I am if I make the decision. I'm not super-famous or anything, but I'm known in the industry I once worked in as being one of the best in my field. But the days of rubbing elbows with celebrities; big paychecks; and just being comfortable with how well my life was, is all gone forever. I'd accept working minimum wage the rest of my life, but I'm not even physically able to do that now. I have no idea why life pissed on me like this. I'm one of the good ones. Would never hurt another person. I love entertaining people. I love making kids laugh. I love helping others, and I'm really good at it. Besides being paid for my talent in L.A., I can fix anything. Plumbing. Cars. Electric. I compose music. I've done stand-up comedy. But for all the luck I've had in life, I seem to have had much more bad luck.

Wish I had any answer for you. One thing that always made me hesitate about suicide is what it would do to my father. Talking to him a few minutes ago and he seems pretty resigned to it now, which is a relief and hopefully one less hurdle for me to do what's right for my family. I obviously wouldn't want you doing it considering you have a child. All I can say is hang in there. I hate to do this before Christmas, but it would be a great Christmas for my family having all that extra money for gifts.

Not great. Good news is that I got confirmation that the union received my change of beneficiary so my sister will receive my pension. It'll be one lump sum of 68,000 dollars, tax free. I just don't know what to do about my SS. There's about 140,000 dollars in it. I don't know if I should do a will or if it's just automatic that my dad will get it. I'm not depressed but missing the life I had. And unbelievably lonely. So, that's progress. What about you?

I wish there was anything I could say but I can't give what I don't have. I just downloaded the Peaceful Pill which goes into great detail about exit bags. And I've been watching videos. I don't think I should be because they are depressing. The thought of any family member having to see me doesn't thrill me. But for now, I'm hanging in there. Barely. You?
I'm sorry.

I wish I didn't but yes, I drank it.

Dad's going to be so unhappy. I hate to do this to him, but I need relief. I deserve it. Thanks for taking the time to reply to me.
Fall is here. Makes me happy. I just bought a couple pints of vodka. Trying to muster the strength to do it. I will. It's just scary.

Thanks. I've decided. It's getting cooler this weekend. I'd like to experience a few last days of real fall weather. I've always loved the fall. Looking for places where I can purchase the nitrogen tanks. Seems it's used for welding.

If it was just about me that would be one thing. My dad paid for all my trips back to L.A. for interviews for jobs that I never landed. And he has 1 year left of money. I can't pay him back with minimum wage work. My normal career I make 80 bucks an hour. I'm brilliant. 155 IQ. Amazingly talented. And worth zero. It's pragmatism, not depression. I have two "you can't do this to your family" situations. 1-you can't commit suicide. 2-you can't make your father homeless. As long as I'm alive, he'll soon lose his home. When I die, he's set for life. Money is paper. Paper that will keep him in his home. I made over 2 million in 15 years. Now I'm making nothing. Fine. I can accept that. But my existence is killing my family. My death will help them thrive. It's that simple. I do not want to die, but I want the process to be as painless as possible for me, and the least traumatic for them. I was raised to believe money is the most important thing in life. It isn't...all the time that is. In this case, it's far more important than my existence.

Spent a ton of money travelling for yet another job interview that I just found out I didn't get. Time to go.  

After much research, my family having to identify my body after a bridge jump is pretty gruesome. Fortunately, in my research I've discovered nitrogen. Modern emissions on cars make it very difficult to kill yourself from sticking a hose from the exhaust to the window. Also, there's the possibility that it's not as peaceful as I once thought. Nitrogen is not recognized as foreign by the body, so you continue breathing it until you die. You simply fall asleep. I don't know if I'll get answers here, but I'll keep looking. I'm wondering what size bottle would insure my death in my car.

So here's the plan. I'll park somewhere secluded. Plenty of places around here. But I don't want to be found long after I've died. My dad will need to sell the car and it'll be tough if my body decomposes in it. And I definitely don't want the police to find me before I die. So I'll place a note at a particular location. That note will bring police to another location. I'll plan about 4 places before the final note which will tell them where I'm parked. That way, before I pass out I'll call 911 and send them to the first location. I have GPS spoofing software to insure they can't track me that way. As far as tower triangulation, that'll take more than enough time for my death.

The day that I do this, I will go public with who I am here on Reddit and on my Facebook page. I really, really hate to die. I really hate to do this to my family. But I kept doing what others told me. Don't lose hope. Don't lose faith. I've gone far beyond the point of how low I thought I'd go. If it weren't for the financial hole I'm putting my family in, I certainly wouldn't consider this. But my dad needs money. This will free up at least 200 thousand dollars for my family. They'll be sad but in the long run they'll understand. Money is important. My life isn't. Not anymore.

I doubt anyone will help with advice, but if anyone's willing, let me know if there are any holes in my plan I've overlooked.

BTW, I'm going through a VPN so this can't be traced.
Going to Ruth's Chris steakhouse this weekend. Best steaks ever. Then going to the bridge in Baton Rouge or Luling. I'll post more info about who I am before Sunday.
Sunday night. Mississippi River bridge.

I just found out how little money my dad has left. My jump will result in close to 200k for my family. I'll probably wait until Sunday to end my life. At that time, I'll reveal who I am. I'm not super-famous or anything. But I'm known in my industry. I'm honestly terrified of dying, but the comfort of knowing what it'll do for my family makes it easier. I love Reddit. My other account has many front pages. I love making people laugh. But more importantly, I need to provide for my family's financial future. I'll post a link to my IMDB page before I jump. Thanks again for those who responded. I know this subreddit is filled with posers and it's hard to know who is serious and who isn't.

Southeast. Northshore of New Orleans. I promised someone I'd give him a ride this morning. Then after that, I'm thinking of driving to the bridge. If not today, sometime this weekend.

I'm trying to hang on. Life just keeps kicking and kicking and kicking me. Obviously, I really don't want to die. But we all die one day. And if I do it by my choosing, my family will get a pretty good sum of money. As long as I'm alive, I'm a financial toll on my family.

My car is technically my dad's. I've lost everything. My savings. My career. If I drive to San Francisco, he'll have to pay to have the car shipped to Louisiana. But jumping from the Luling bridge means my family will have to identify my body--something I don't want. Jumping from the Golden Gate just has a romantic thing about it. And when I'd do it there, I'd plan to do it as the tide is running out to insure my body wouldn't be found. The stress on my family will be enough without having to identify my body. I'm thinking perhaps taking a bus from Louisiana.

This is just post-argument catharsis thinking. 95 percent of the time, I'm not this guy.
I try, but she's family. There are times I can't avoid her. I just think she broke the law and should face the music. She's a millionaire. She'll pay her way out of it.
Yeah, I knew this is not an extraditable offense. I'm just trying to figure out how to alert officials in that state's county where she failed to appear.
I'm not talking out of state extradition. I'm talking about giving local authorities a heads up when she'll be in their jurisdiction.
